clause_coverages.coverage_note: STF XML well-formedness, DOCTYPE reference to local util/dtd/ich-stf-v2-2.dtd, and local DTD validation are executable when the DTD resolves; unresolved validation prerequisites remain explicit guidance.

clause_coverages.heading: 5.2 检查索引引用
clause_coverages.coverage_note: STF XML leaf xlink:href target-existence boundary is covered by the same bounded package file-resolution check used for index.xml and regional XML references.

clause_coverages.heading: 5.3 不建议使用“content-block”元素
clause_coverages.coverage_note: STF XML content-block usage is detected directly from preserved XML element records and surfaced as a validation-standard warning.

clause_coverages.heading: 5.4 文件引用值不能使用反斜杠
clause_coverages.coverage_note: STF XML xlink:href values containing backslashes are detected from preserved XML attribute records as a hard validation error.

clause_coverages.heading: 5.5 研究标识的类别不能空
clause_coverages.coverage_note: STF study-identifier category values are checked for missing or blank content from objective XML element text evidence.

clause_coverages.heading: 5.6 研究标识的研究ID不能为空
clause_coverages.coverage_note: STF study-identifier study-id values are checked for missing or blank content from objective XML element text evidence.

clause_coverages.heading: 5.7 研究标识的标题必须与叶元素的叶标题匹配
clause_coverages.coverage_note: STF study-identifier title values are compared with uniquely resolved index.xml leaf titles via doc-content href to leaf ID evidence; unresolved or ambiguous references remain prerequisite guidance.

clause_coverages.heading: 5.8 标签属性和类别元素的值
clause_coverages.coverage_note: STF file-tag name attributes and named category values are checked against the local Attachment 2-6 valid-values.xml bundle when comparable values are available.

clause_coverages.heading: 5.9 STF的增补操作
clause_coverages.coverage_note: STF-scoped index.xml append operations are checked so their modified-file target must resolve to another locally classifiable STF leaf; missing historical target metadata remains prerequisite/human-review guidance.

clause_coverages.heading: 5.10 STF必须提供类别元素（category）信息
clause_coverages.coverage_note: STF study-identifier category presence is checked for the explicitly category-required CTD sections 4.2.3.1, 4.2.3.2, 4.2.3.4.1, and 5.3.5.1 using index.xml section context or clear numeric path evidence; unmapped STF files remain prerequisite/human-review guidance.

clause_coverages.heading: 5.11 STF不能引用另一个STF
clause_coverages.coverage_note: STF XML leaf references are checked for locally resolvable targets that are strongly classifiable as another STF XML document; unresolved XML targets and ambiguous classifications remain prerequisite/human-review guidance.

clause_coverages.heading: 5.12 STF文件必须至少引用一个叶元素
clause_coverages.coverage_note: STF XML files are checked for at least one leaf element reference from objective XML element structure evidence.

clause_coverages.heading: 5.13 STF的“study-id”值必须保持一致
clause_coverages.coverage_note: STF study-id lifecycle consistency is checked only when index.xml replace/append lifecycle metadata links a current STF XML file to a locally available modified-file STF XML file and both sides have unique non-empty study-id values; missing history or ambiguous STF identity remains prerequisite/human-review guidance.

clause_coverages.heading: 5.14 无效的STF目录位置
clause_coverages.coverage_note: STF-like XML files are checked against bounded module directory classification for Module 4 4.2.x and Module 5 5.3.1.x-5.3.5.x, with unclassified paths kept as prerequisite guidance.

clause_coverages.heading: 5.15 STF“doc-content”的标签（file-tag）数量
clause_coverages.coverage_note: Each STF doc-content element is checked for exactly one direct file-tag child from objective XML element structure evidence.

clause_coverages.heading: 5.16 5.3.7章节病例报告表结构
clause_coverages.coverage_note: When index.xml shows explicit STF usage in the current sequence, Module 5 section 5.3.7 case-report-form leafs are prohibited using local leaf structure evidence; absent STF usage remains not applicable/prerequisite guidance.

clause_coverages.heading: 5.17 使用STF
clause_coverages.coverage_note: STF-required zones in Module 4 section 4.2 and Module 5 sections 5.3.1 through 5.3.5 are checked for explicit STF parent structure using index.xml leaf records; cross-document STF content completeness remains prerequisite/human-review guidance.

clause_coverages.heading: 5.18 临床试验数据集相关文件必须使用正确的STF文件标签
clause_coverages.coverage_note: Module 5 STF dataset references are checked for the validation-standard 5.18 file-tag/file-type mapping when a doc-content has a directly comparable xpt dataset or define.xml leaf and a unique file-tag name; incomplete STF structure remains prerequisite guidance.

clause_coverages.heading: 5.19 申请人递交的药物临床试验数据必须有正确的数据集文件和
clause_coverages.coverage_note: Module 5 STF dataset package families are checked for required dm/adsl xpt dataset and matching data-definition evidence when raw data-tabulation or analysis dataset family tags are locally comparable; broader clinical database completeness remains prerequisite/human-review guidance.

clause_coverages.heading: 5.20 同一个研究下提交的数据集不能重名
clause_coverages.coverage_note: Module 5 STF dataset names are checked for duplicates within a single local STF study document using normalized xpt filename stems from directly comparable dataset doc-content entries; cross-document same-study grouping and broader package inventory completeness remain prerequisite/human-review guidance.

clause_coverages.heading: 6.1 PDF文件必须可读。
clause_coverages.coverage_note: PDF readability boundary is executable from bounded parser openability and page-count metadata, including graceful unreadable-file fallback.

clause_coverages.heading: 6.2 书签必须指向相对路径
clause_coverages.coverage_note: PDF bookmark relative-path boundary is executable from raw outline/bookmark external-file `/F` target strings without broader target-existence or viewer semantics.

clause_coverages.heading: 6.3 有网页、邮箱地址或其他外部链接的书签
clause_coverages.coverage_note: PDF bookmark external-link boundary is executable from raw outline/bookmark URI target strings such as web or mail links; broader target reachability remains outside this deterministic check.

clause_coverages.heading: 6.4 不允许有未知动作的书签
clause_coverages.coverage_note: PDF bookmark action whitelist boundary is executable from raw outline/bookmark action dictionaries and their `/S` action names; missing metadata remains prerequisite/NA rather than assumed.

clause_coverages.heading: 6.5 书签不能失效
clause_coverages.coverage_note: PDF invalid-bookmark boundary is executable for bookmarks that expose neither an assigned action nor a destination in raw outline/bookmark metadata; broader damaged-target semantics remain separate.

clause_coverages.heading: 6.6 书签不能被损坏
clause_coverages.coverage_note: PDF damaged-bookmark boundary is executable for raw internal bookmark destinations whose destination array is empty, malformed, or points to a non-page object; viewer-normalized navigation behavior is not used as evidence.

clause_coverages.heading: 6.7 书签不能有多个动作
clause_coverages.coverage_note: PDF bookmark single-action boundary is executable from raw outline/bookmark action dictionaries that contain explicit `/Next` action-chain markers; top-level outline sibling `/Next` pointers are not counted.

clause_coverages.heading: 6.8 书签必须承前缩放（Inherit Zoom）
clause_coverages.coverage_note: PDF bookmark inherited-zoom boundary is executable from raw destination arrays: `/XYZ` destinations with `null` or `0` zoom are accepted as inherited/current zoom, while Fit-style or explicit non-zero zoom destinations are surfaced as warnings.

clause_coverages.heading: 6.9 超文本链接必须使用相对路径
clause_coverages.coverage_note: PDF hyperlink relative-path boundary is executable from bounded external-file link target strings without broader viewer semantics.

clause_coverages.heading: 6.10 有网页、邮箱地址或其他外部链接的超文本链接
clause_coverages.coverage_note: PDF external hyperlink prohibition is executable from bounded external URI hyperlink counts without broader hyperlink-action semantics.

clause_coverages.heading: 6.11 不允许有未知动作的超文本链接
clause_coverages.coverage_note: PDF hyperlink action whitelist boundary is executable from bounded link-annotation action names extracted from raw PDF link objects.

clause_coverages.heading: 6.12 超文本链接不能处于失效状态
clause_coverages.coverage_note: Broken hyperlink boundary is executable from bounded raw link objects that lack any valid action or destination.

clause_coverages.heading: 6.13 超文本链接不能被损坏
clause_coverages.coverage_note: PDF broken-hyperlink prohibition is executable from bounded raw link objects that lack any valid action or destination.

clause_coverages.heading: 6.14 超文本链接不能有多个动作
clause_coverages.coverage_note: PDF hyperlink single-action boundary is executable from explicit raw link-annotation `/Next` action-chain markers; missing metadata remains prerequisite/NA rather than assumed.

clause_coverages.heading: 6.15 超文本链接必须承前缩放（Inherit Zoom）
clause_coverages.coverage_note: PDF hyperlink inherited-zoom boundary is executable from raw link annotation destination arrays: `/XYZ` destinations with `null` or `0` zoom are accepted as inherited/current zoom, while Fit-style or explicit non-zero zoom destinations are surfaced as warnings.

clause_coverages.heading: 6.16 PDF版本必须正确
clause_coverages.coverage_note: Allowed PDF-version boundary is executable from bounded format metadata.

clause_coverages.heading: 6.17 不允许带附件的PDF文件
clause_coverages.coverage_note: Embedded PDF attachment prohibition is executable from bounded parser metadata.

clause_coverages.heading: 6.18 有注释的PDF文件
clause_coverages.coverage_note: Non-link PDF annotation restriction is executable from bounded parser metadata.

clause_coverages.heading: 6.19 PDF文件不能有任何安全设置
clause_coverages.coverage_note: PDF security-setting prohibition is executable from bounded encryption and permission metadata.

clause_coverages.heading: 6.20 PDF初始视图正确
clause_coverages.coverage_note: Initial-view default boundary is executable from bounded catalog metadata (`PageMode`, `PageLayout`, `OpenAction`).

clause_coverages.heading: 6.21 PDF文件不能有密码保护
clause_coverages.coverage_note: Password-protected PDF prohibition is executable from bounded parser preflight metadata.

clause_coverages.heading: 6.22 PDF应该设置启用“快速Web访问（Fast Web Access）”
clause_coverages.coverage_note: PDF Fast Web Access boundary is executable from objective PDF linearization metadata detected near the file header; missing linearization evidence remains prerequisite/NA rather than assumed.

clause_coverages.heading: 6.23 大于5页的文件必须有书签
clause_coverages.coverage_note: Long-PDF bookmark requirement is executable from embedded outline metadata.

clause_coverages.heading: 6.24 PDF内容限制
clause_coverages.coverage_note: Disallowed active-content boundary is executable from bounded object-marker detection (`JavaScript`, `3D`, `RichMedia`, `Movie`, `Sound`, `Screen`).

clause_coverages.heading: 6.25 PDF内容可搜索
clause_coverages.coverage_note: PDF searchable-text boundary is executable from existing parser text-layer evidence: readable non-exempt PDFs with pages must expose content evidence or content units; scanned pages without extractable text remain OCR/manual-review warnings.

clause_coverages.heading: 6.26 如使用非标准字体，需嵌入在PDF文件中
clause_coverages.coverage_note: PDF non-standard font embedding is executable from objective page font records and embedded font-program markers; missing font metadata remains prerequisite/NA rather than assumed.

recommended_next_direction.primary_reason: The remaining validation-standard Chapter 4 partials are intentionally held at a human-review and prerequisite boundary: schema reference/schema validation require local schema resources and validation diagnostics, while schema-version and envelope immutability checks require historical sequence evidence.
recommended_next_direction.secondary_reason: Further automation should start only after a local schema-validation path or a trusted multi-sequence history comparison path exists; otherwise keep the clauses as prerequisite guidance rather than false coverage.
